Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY 65 — back to Run 16 setting. AREA 0 fits at 65% (Run 16 confirmed); gives placer more room for short routes which helps timing.
CLOCK_PERIOD = 10 ns. Synth + PnR see this. Run 29 closed timing at 10ns (WNS +0.066). Signoff still hardcoded to 17.5 ns via pnr_signoff.sdc.
PNR_SDC_FILE intentionally unset → falls back to base.sdc which reads CLOCK_PERIOD=12. Keeps PnR consistent with synth.
Hold slack margin lowered 0.15 → 0.05 / 0.1 → 0.05 — current hold WNS is +1ns at slow corner so we have headroom; smaller margin = less hold-fix delay = better setup
Setup slack margin reverted to defaults (Run 11's bump 0.17→0.35 backfired ~0.4ns)
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!

RUN_LINTER=0: verilator 5.046 cannot resolve sky130 UDP 'sky130_fd_sc_hd__udp_pwrgood_pp$PG' even with LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS=0 (the generated .bb.v still references it). Tool/PDK version incompatibility, not an RTL issue. User RTL was hand-checked + simulated 11/11 PASS.
SYNTH_STRATEGY back to AREA 0. AREA 3 had best pre-PnR WNS but failed LVS (Run 22) and didn't fit with padding (Run 23). AREA 0 is the only fully-clean strategy on this die.

MAX_FANOUT_CONSTRAINT removed — Run 34 proved it backfires (clone cells at default drive strength created 73 new slew + 7 cap violations). RTL keep_hierarchy on MixColumns is the targeted fix for cross-column fanout.
Clock gating
SDC Customizations
Routing tweaks. Slew repair tightening reverted (Run 30 with 20+8 regressed timing 0.26ns AND increased slew vios 8→21).
DRT_OPT_ITERS reverted 64 → 40 (Run 24 effort revert; default 64 didn't help setup since DRC was already clean).

GLB_RESIZER_TIMING_OPTIMIZATIONS=1 with GRT_RESIZER_RUN_GRT=0 (below). Run 13 showed the postGRT resizer DOES improve WNS to ~-1.5 ns from -2.5 ns; it only crashed in the FINAL re-route step (rsz_timing_postgrt.tcl line 60) on newly-inserted buffer nets missing guides. Skipping that final re-route keeps the resizer's improvements.

GRT_RESIZER_RUN_GRT=1 (default) lets the final re-route after resizing run, so detailed routing has guides for the new buffers. Run 15 showed that with gate cloning off, the original GRT-0076 may not recur; if it does we'll need a different approach.
Disable gate cloning. Run 15 confirmed: with cloning OFF, postGRT resizer (stage 39) completes successfully — gate cloning was the source of unguided nets in Run 13/14 GRT-0076 crashes.
